verdict.rationale: Green and Spiegel is an immigration law firm offering legal consultation and visa-processing services, not a software or data-hosting product, so self-serve export of user data in open formats is a category error for this kind of offering. Nothing in the evidence shows the firm ships any data-export capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
